findings.claim: A reversed range citation (path:first-last with first > last) passes the evidence check unread, even when first is past the file's end.
The give-up message, ADR 0017 correction and how-to say "after five tries", but the agent sends six reports (one plus five retries) before the run stops.
The render docstring still says it returns the summary, counts, then a table; it now also returns the checked list.
